en.text:
Weapon Kills trigger a <solar/>Solar explosion that applies 30 <solar/>Scorch Stacks (#e${40+#d} with <solar/>Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.

Killing <link Elite or higher tier Combatants [#CombatantClassifications] /> and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies #e${10+#d} more <solar/>Scorch Stacks.

<solar/>Scorch damage can be increased through <link Weapon Damage Buffs [#DamageBuffs] />.

enhanced (
var d = 5
#e Having <solar/>Ember of Ashes equipped or Killing higher-tier targets each increase the amount of <solar/>Scorch applied by 5 Stacks.
)
